LanguageData.MST.ManeuverComment: Click to jump to this maneuver type's row. The damage type on maneuver rows (weapons / races / hediffs) is a mirror of this row: editing it here or there affects every object using this maneuver.
LanguageData.MST.meleeDamageDefComment: The damage type this maneuver deals. It is shared across the whole table: every weapon, race and hediff maneuver with the same capacity (e.g. Cut) reads this one value, so changing it changes all of them. To change a single weapon, edit that weapon's maneuver values on the weapon tab.
LanguageData.MST.requiredCapacityComment: The body capacity (ToolCapacityDef) required to use this maneuver type. Weapon / race maneuvers are matched to this row by it. The editor does not support editing this item.
